verdict.rationale: Chronicle's core product is a sandbox for agent testing. Agents read and write simulated "twins" of services such as Slack, Linear, Salesforce and SAP through the vendor's API instead of the real systems. Each trial gets fresh, isolated twins built from a frozen world, and reset restores the original seed, so runs never reach production. Production data is copied into staging environments for testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees; all evidence is vendor documentation.
